trial_court: Court of Civil Judge-07 (Central), Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi - CS SCJ No. : 1519/21
case_name: Kapil Jain vs Sh. D K Jain

parties.respondent_defendant: Sh. D.K Jain, Proprietor, D.K Jain & Sons

facts_of_case: The plaintiff is a proprietary firm trading under the name and style of M/S Arihant Automobiles. The defendant approached the plaintiff for the purchase of goods. A sum of Rs. 1,81,609/- was due and payable against the defendant. The defendant issued a cheque which was dishonoured.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the plaintiff to prove that the defendant has not cleared his account and made complete payment of goods purchased.
legal_principles.held: It is the case of the plaintiff that the plaintiff supplied the goods to the defendant from the year 2017 to 2019 as per the orders received from the defendant but the defendant failed to pay for the goods purchased.

legal_principles.principle: A plaintiff cannot file a case under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881, if they have already settled the matter with the defendant.
legal_principles.held: Despite taking Rs. 25,000/, the plaintiff filed the case u/s 138 NIA with respect to the said cheque.

outcome.final_order: The plaintiff is entitled to recover Rs. 2,83,310/- along with interest @24% from 10.09.2018 till 10.01.2021.
